questions.passage: Born in 1888 in Bombay (now Mumbai), India, Sarojini Naidu was a talented poet and political leader. She received the nickname "The Nightingale of India" because of __________. She began writing poetry at age 12 and was soon recognized for her literary talent. In 1905, her first collection of poems was published. Later she joined India's struggle for freedom from British rule. As a powerful speaker, she traveled widely and influenced many people. She became the first woman to serve as the president of the Indian National Congress in 1925. After India's independence, she served as the governor of the Uttar Pradesh province until her death in 1949.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: the beauty of her poetry=시의 아름다움 ('인도의 나이팅게일' 별명의 이유)
det.analysis:
✅ ① the beauty of her poetry: 원문 일치. 시의 아름다움 때문에 별명을 받았다 ←정답
❌ ② her political ambition: 별명의 원인은 정치적 야망이 아님
❌ ③ her wealthy family background: 가정 배경은 별명과 무관
❌ ④ her talent for public speaking: 연설 재능은 나이팅게일과 관련성 낮음
det.tip: received the nickname because of the beauty of her poetry
